overview_description.description: ZIQQI is one of the fastest growing Technology companies in Africa. As the only B2B eCommerce Wholesaler serving sub-saharan Africa the company deploys a country strategy through local partnership. ZIQQI is an integrated platform comprised of purchasing, payments, logistics, customer service and internet finance. The company provides a total end-to-end eCommerce solution-in-a-box across African markets with full connectivity to local payment platforms. ZIQQI brings the Global Supply Chain to the doorstep of Africans complete with local last-mile logistics and service.
